exposure: two or more consecutive medical uterine evacuations
two or more consecutive surgical uterine evacuations
outcome: composite of spontaneous preterm birth and low birthweight
cohort: The study participants were women who had either two or more consecutive medical evacuations, two or more consecutive surgical evacuations, or no previous evacuations, all of whom subsequently had a singleton delivery.
finding: Two or more consecutive surgical evacuations were associated with a significantly increased risk of spontaneous preterm birth and low birthweight in the subsequent singleton delivery compared to women with no previous evacuations.
